description: POLARIS provides an integrated travel and freight-demand, dynamic-assignment and transport-simulation platform. The provider is Argonne National Laboratory. Geographical and temporal coverage: Argonne's POLARIS documentation describes simultaneous network and travel decisions; each configured model defines its coverage. The documentation explains licence requests and links demonstration models. Running POLARIS requires a licence; none was requested in this review. The licence is Licence required from Argonne National Laboratory; terms supplied through the request process. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to platform-helics, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted. Access information is supplied through the linked documentation.
